name: Martha Lips
bio: Robert Sherard's wife, whom he married in 1886. The editors of Wilde's letters describe her only as 'a Polish girl called Martha Lips'. Wilde, writing to Sherard in Paris about two years later, asked after 'your pretty, romantic looking wife with her lovely eyes'.
bio_note: Both statements are from the Complete Letters: the marriage from the editors' note at printed 347, Wilde's description from the letter at printed 348 (PDF 369-370, both folios confirmed). Dates: none recorded, and almost nothing else is: the record preserves her nationality, her name, the year she married, and one sentence a friend of her husband's wrote about her eyes.
